auth.privacy.heading: How the union handles your data
auth.privacy.lead: Short and honest: what we store, why, and who can see it.
auth.privacy.collected.title: What we collect
auth.privacy.collected.text: Your name, email, group and school, plus your phone number and bio if you added them. Also what you do here: the missions you take, your reports and the files attached to them, coins, rewards and department applications.
auth.privacy.purpose.title: Why
auth.privacy.purpose.text: To run the Student Union's missions and coins: to show the rating, award coins for accepted reports and hand out rewards.
auth.privacy.audience.title: Who can see it
auth.privacy.audience.text: Every member sees your name, group, coins, level and badges — that is the rating. Your email and phone number are visible only to you, your department coordinator and the admins. Your report text and any attached files are visible to you, the coordinator of the mission's department and the admins.
auth.privacy.retention.title: How long we keep it
auth.privacy.retention.text: As long as your account exists. You can delete your account from your profile: your name, email and phone number are anonymised, and your coin history stays but is no longer tied to you — the union needs it for its records.
auth.privacy.rights.title: Your rights
auth.privacy.rights.text: You can correct your own details in your profile. For anything about your data, message the Student Union chair.
